lines: A joker is a little fool who is different from everyone
else. He’s not a club, diamond, heart, or spade. He’s
not an eight or a nine, a king or a jack. He is an
outsider. He is placed in the same pack as the other
cards, but he doesn’t belong there. Therefore, he can
be removed without anybody missing him.
